query:
INSERT INTO account_research_chunks (
    organization_id,
    account_id,
    data_type,
    derived_output_key,
    topic_tags,
    source_type,
    source_reference,
    confidence,
    content,
    input_chunk_ids,
    prompt_id,
    prompt_version,
    retrieval_query,
    model_id,
    generated_at
)
VALUES (
    $1,
    $2,
    'DERIVED_OUTPUT'::account_research_chunk_data_type,
    $3,
    $4,
    $5::account_research_chunk_source_type,
    COALESCE($6, $3),
    $7,
    $8,
    $9,
    $10,
    $11,
    $12,
    $13,
    $14
)
ON CONFLICT (organization_id, account_id)
    WHERE data_type = 'DERIVED_OUTPUT'::account_research_chunk_data_type
      AND derived_output_key = 'fitScore'
      AND superseded_by IS NULL
DO UPDATE
SET
    topic_tags = EXCLUDED.topic_tags,
    source_type = EXCLUDED.source_type,
    source_reference = EXCLUDED.source_reference,
    confidence = EXCLUDED.confidence,
    content = EXCLUDED.content,
    input_chunk_ids = EXCLUDED.input_chunk_ids,
    prompt_id = EXCLUDED.prompt_id,
    prompt_version = EXCLUDED.prompt_version,
    retrieval_query = EXCLUDED.retrieval_query,
    model_id = EXCLUDED.model_id,
    generated_at = EXCLUDED.generated_at,
    version = account_research_chunks.version + 1,
    updated_at = now()
RETURNING
    id,
    organization_id,
    account_id,
    data_type AS "data_type: AccountResearchChunkDataType",
    topic_tags AS "topic_tags!: Vec<String>",
    source_type AS "source_type: AccountResearchChunkSourceType",
    source_reference,
    chunk_topic,
    confidence,
    content AS "content!: JsonValue",
    version,
    superseded_by,
    input_chunk_ids AS "input_chunk_ids?: Vec<Uuid>",
    prompt_id,
    prompt_version,
    retrieval_query AS "retrieval_query: JsonValue",
    model_id,
    generated_at,
    created_at,
    updated_at
